# Changelog

## 2.0.0 — breaking

**Tokens are now real W3C DTCG and are the only thing you edit.** Everything else is generated by `npm run build` and checked by `npm test` (also in CI).

### Structure
- `tokens/tokens.json` split into `primitives`, `semantic` (light), `semantic.dark` and `dataviz` `.tokens.json` files using `$value` / `$type` / `$description` and `{alias}` references.
- New generated outputs in `dist/`: `tokens.css` (`--cds-*` variables, light + dark), `tailwind.css` (Tailwind v4 `@theme` + shadcn/ui variable names), `tokens.js` + `tokens.d.ts` (chart palettes for Recharts), `tokens.resolved.json`.
- `powerbi/changent-powerbi-theme.json` is now generated.
- `css/changent-ds.css` keeps the utility classes and v1 `--c-*` names as deprecated aliases.

### Power BI theme (was largely ignored by Power BI in v1)
- Fixed the `visualStyles` structure: every card was written `{prop: [{value}]}` instead of Power BI's `[{prop: value}]`.
- Removed invalid top-level keys `outspacePane`, `filterPane`, `pageTooltip`; filter pane now styled via `page.outspacePane` / `filterCard`.
- `matrix` → `pivotTable`; table `header` → `columnHeaders`; pie/donut `dataLabels` → `labels` placed outside.
- No text below 12pt (was 11 almost everywhere); data labels, table cells and slicer items at 14pt.
- Removed white data labels on cyan/orange/green fills (2.06–2.92:1).
- `good` #80B036 → #198F51, `bad` #C0392B → #C00000, `maximum` #18216D → #3FC4E0 (matches the KPI diverging scale).
- Added structural colors (`firstLevelElements`…`fourthLevelElements`, `secondaryBackground`, `hyperlink`, `disabledText`).
- Validated against the official schema and every property name checked (342).

### Value changes (Phase 0 decisions)
- Critical red: `#C00000` everywhere (the dataviz palette PDF's `#C0392B` retired).
- Text: `#1A1A18` (17.43:1) replaces `#22292A` as `text.primary`. `#22292A` stays as primitive `grey.800`.
- Borders: `border.default` `#808285` (≥3:1 on every light surface, WCAG 1.4.11). `#E5E6E6` becomes `border.divider` (decorative only). App value `#E0DEDD` retired.
- Muted text: `#626875` replaces `#6B7280` (failed 4.5:1 on grey/tint surfaces).
- Status "below target / at risk": amber `#F3C11B` (confirmed). README rule "orange = below target" corrected.
- `neutral.on-fill` white → `#1A1A18` (white was 3.33:1).
- Navy: `#18216D` is the only UI navy; `#051E48` only via `surface.inverse`.
- Typography: 14 minimum for content, 12 only for tooltips, footnotes, legends and axis titles, nothing below 12.

### Added
- 5-stop sequential scales (v1 had 3), financial diverging and priority scales, interaction tints (`navy.050/075/950`), dark mode.
- Fixed typo `#8D3510` → `#8B3510`.
